About

Meet Ate Em

Emily Baysa — “Ate Em” to everyone at the window — runs Kanto Treats by Ems Kusina, the Filipino street food truck she started under EMS KUSINA LLC in 2021.

“Kanto” means street corner — and that’s exactly the food: the siomai, kwek-kwek, empanada and ihaw-ihaw you’d grab on a corner back home in the Philippines, cooked fresh from the truck here in the Bay Area.

Guests consistently describe the food as authentic and home-cooked, and Ate Em’s welcome as the reason they come back. Come hungry, order at the window, and stay for the kwento.
